_label: Small-fixture correctness and timing comparison -- not a production scale benchmark.

environment.note: Exasol runs in Docker on developer laptop. Exasol timings include SQL query dispatch, network round-trip, and result-set fetch over loopback. In-process pandas runs directly in local RAM.

degree_minutes_scope_reconciliation.explanation: 281.20 DM measures strictly the 45-min excursion window (10:10-10:55 UTC). 289.12 DM measures the whole 60-min handoff window (10:00-11:00 UTC), including 7.92 DM from 3 cooldown minutes (10:55-10:58 UTC) inside H2 that remained above 8.0 C.

summary.measured_finding: In-process pandas was faster on this small fixture due to zero network IPC overhead.

scale_testing.reason: Large-scale testing was not completed due to single-node container memory limits and local execution boundaries.
